trace.final:
Summary of what was done:

1. **Diagnosed** — `checkout-api` v2.3.1 (latest deploy) was failing health checks in all production regions with an 18% error rate. Deployment history showed v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production.
2. **Rolled back** — All regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) rolled back to **v2.3.0**. No change-manager approval was required because v2.3.0 had already been healthy in production.
3. **Verified** — Service is now healthy in all regions with error rate down to ~0.2%.
4. **Incident opened** — SEV2 incident **INC-0001** created for checkout-api documenting the failed v2.3.1 deploy and the rollback to v2.3.0; on-call was paged.
